subject: Your payslip for $period_name is ready
body:
Dear $staff_name,

Your payslip for $period_name is ready. Sign in to the HR portal and open Payroll › My Payslips to view it.

Pay date: $pay_date
Reference: $record_id

For your security this e-mail does not contain any pay details.

QUERIES

  • Differences vs last period: usually allowances, overtime, unpaid leave or a tax-code change. Check the breakdown in the portal first.
  • Tax code questions: go through HMRC directly; HR cannot change a tax code.
  • Anything else: payroll@university.edu — quote reference $record_id.

Kind regards,
Payroll Team
